# DuckDuckGo attribution

`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/duckduckgo_logo.png` is DuckDuckGo's official
256-pixel site icon, downloaded without modification from
https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/favicons/DDG-icon_256x256.png (linked from
https://duckduckgo.com/press), 29 October 2026. The name and logo are trademarks
of Duck Duck Go, Inc.; this is attribution, not an endorsement.

The app displays the logo and “Results from DuckDuckGo” linked to a relevant
DuckDuckGo result page, with separate publisher source links. It uses only the
public Instant Answer API (`https://api.duckduckgo.com/`, `format=json`,
`t=betterintelligence`), without an API key, JSONP or search-page scraping.
Sources distinguish publisher bodies from labelled stable-topic API summaries; API summaries are not independent publisher verification.

Publisher-authored API reference (archived):
https://github.com/duckduckgo/duckduckgo-publisher/blob/master/share/site/duckduckgo/api.tx
